subject: Evidence request: personnel training, background checks, and offboarding snapshots (SOC2)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <audit@ondine-audit.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel training & offboarding evidence for upcoming SOC 2 gap review

Marcus / Karthik —

Ondine is starting the gap assessment for Bluecrest's engagement next week and we need a few personnel artifacts from Redwood to complete our control sampling for CC7 (personnel) and CC9 (access revocation). Can you provide a 1–2 week turnaround on the items below? Deadline: 2025-06-25.

Requested items (sample of last 12 months):
- Training completion roster (security awareness + data handling): CSV or exported report with user email, course name, completion date, and status.
- Background check attestations or redacted reports for hires since Jan 2024 (redact SSNs).
- Offboarding evidence: access revocation timings for leavers (timestamp + system).
- Signed personnel attestation that screening/training are completed per your policy.

If there are any scoped exclusions (contractors, interns), flag them in your response. Also let us know if you prefer a shared Drive upload or an encrypted zip via secure transfer.

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Senior IT Audit Manager, Ondine Audit
 audit@ondine-audit.com

[attachment: Ondine_Evidence_Template.xlsx]

From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: Lena Ortiz <audit@ondine-audit.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel training & offboarding evidence for upcoming SOC 2 gap review

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can put this together for you. Quick clarifications so we send exactly what you need:

1) Preferred format: we can provide CSV exports and redacted PDFs. Do you need original background report PDFs or just our HR attestations + redaction?
2) Scope: are you sampling company-wide or only Bluecrest-scoped users (we have dedicated tenancy for some partners)? If company-wide, we will include all Redwood employees; if scoped to Bluecrest, please send the list of primary contacts.
3) Offboarding systems: our revocation log will include Okta, GCS (storage), and internal GitLab. Is that sufficient?

Planned deliverable (if OK):
- training_roster_Q1_2025.csv (CSV)
- redacted_bg_reports_2024.zip (redacted PDFs per your guidance)
- offboarding_revocation_log.csv (Okta/GCS/GitLab timestamps)
- personnel_attestation_signed.pdf (signed by HR lead)

We can upload to a shared Drive folder (preferred) and send a link, or deliver encrypted zip. I can assemble an initial drop by Friday 2025-06-20 for your early review and follow-up items by 2025-06-25.

Assigning Stephanie to coordinate the redaction work — looping her in.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of People Ops (contracting security liaison)
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

[attachment: none yet — will upload]

From: Lena Ortiz <audit@ondine-audit.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: James Park <j.park@bluecrest.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel training & offboarding evidence for upcoming SOC 2 gap review

Marcus / Stephanie —

Thanks, that plan works. A few specifics to make our sampling easier:
- Backgrounds: redacted PDFs are fine; please remove SSNs, but keep date of birth and vendor name (e.g., ClearCheck) in the header so we can validate chain.
- Training: include user role (engineer, product, sales) in the CSV if possible; we'll stratify sampling across roles.
- Offboarding: please include UTC timestamps and the actor who revoked access.

Scope: Bluecrest asked for vendor-scoped evidence (users who had access to Bluecrest sandbox in last 12 months). I will attach a short list of ~18 unique emails we want sampled — see attachment.

Delivery: Drive folder is perfect. Please upload to the folder below and set the link to share with Ondine Audit and Bluecrest.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-evidence

If you can drop an initial package Friday (as proposed) we will mark for triage and report any missing elements by Tuesday 2025-06-23.

Lena Ortiz
Ondine Audit
[attachment: bluecrest_sample_emails.csv]

Lena / James —

Initial package uploaded to the Drive folder you shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-evidence

Summary of contents (first drop):
- training_roster_Q1_2025.csv — includes email, full name, role, course name, completion date, status. (CSV)
- redacted_bg_reports_2024.zip — redacted vendor PDFs for hires since Jan 2024 (SSNs removed). (zip)
- offboarding_revocation_log.csv — revocation timestamp (UTC), user email, system (Okta/GCS/GitLab), revoked_by. (CSV)
- personnel_attestation_signed.pdf — signed HR attestation confirming policy alignment and sample selection method. (PDF)

Notes and exceptions:
- Contractors marked with "contractor" in the role column; we excluded contingent contractors not in Bluecrest's access group unless requested.
- A small set of legacy hires (n=3) have vendor-format background PDFs that require an extra redaction pass; those are in the folder with a REDACTION_PENDING.txt flag. We'll complete that by 2025-06-23.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the files are accessible to both Ondine and Bluecrest. If everything looks fine we'll push the final redactions and a signed chain-of-custody spreadsheet by 2025-06-23.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marcus Lin
Head of People Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
